text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on Грасс Вандер and
Спешл Уик
as the Arima Kinen finally
gets underway.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер expresses her
appreciation and
respect for all the
Umamusume running, but
declares that
she won't allow any of them to take
her
lead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then walks to the arena for today's

monumental race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
